query_text: who sings the christmas song all i want for christmas is you

content.text: The classic Christmas song **"All I Want for Christmas Is You"** is sung by **Mariah Carey**. It was released in 1994 as part of her holiday album *Merry Christmas*. The song was co-written and co-produced by Mariah Carey and Walter Afanasieff. It has become one of the best-selling singles of all time and is considered one of the greatest Christmas songs ever recorded.
